data.one_liner: Official Flutter Material UI library implementing Google’s Material Design system.
data.what_it_does: Provides a complete set of Material widgets, theming tools, and localization support for Flutter apps. Includes migration helpers to replace the built‑in material library.
use_when: You need the full suite of Material Design widgets and theming in a separate package
You are migrating an existing app from the built‑in material library to a decoupled package
You want official, up‑to‑date Material 3 components and APIs
avoid_when: Your app only uses Cupertino or custom design systems
You need a minimal footprint and can work with the core flutter/material library
You require non‑Material UI components such as charts or maps
strengths: Built‑in migration tools and compatibility bridge
weaknesses: Adds package size on top of the core Flutter SDK
Duplicates functionality already available in flutter/material

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides the official iOS‑style widget set if you prefer Cupertino design instead of Material

alternatives.name: animations
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers focused animation utilities without pulling in the full Material widget library

alternatives.name: widgetbook
alternatives.why_pick_it: Helps catalog and preview UI components, useful if you need a design system explorer rather than the widgets themselves
